method_notes: **FILE, THEN LET THE REFUTER KEEP RUNNING, THEN REWRITE IN PLACE.** I filed `0656Z` and rewrote it minutes later on a refuter's evidence. Waiting for every refuter before filing would have delayed an operational finding by 20 minutes; filing without them would have published three errors. Do both.

**COMMITTER DATE IS NOT LANDING ORDER.** Two branch-local committer dates told me a fix was undone 3h25m later; `--is-ancestor` and the first-parent tree showed the rule merged 23m42s AFTER the file was already indexed -- born inert, opposite arrow. The same trap ran the other way on the exam artefacts and made cycle 48 *right*. Use `git merge-base --is-ancestor` and test the first-parent tree of each merge, every time.

**`--diff-filter=A` means ADDED, and `--is-ancestor` NO can mean 'modified later', not 'did not exist'.** I read a later *modification* as the *addition* and invented an explanation for a delay that never happened. Always ask `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- <path>` before saying a file arrived late.

**When a referee has already written down why your reading is wrong, you will find it in their MAILBOX, not the audit dir.** OPS-M's pre-emptive ruling against my framing was at `monitor/mailbox/OPS-M.md:543-547`. Prior-art search must cover `monitor/mailbox/`, `monitor/inbox/`, `monitor/board/{items,claimed,done}/` AND `monitor/audit/` -- and search the SHAPE, not the string.

**Absence in a log is not absence of the event if the log itself stopped.** My base rate 'zero revivals' came from `reflex.log`, which has lost every cycle-summary line since 01:33:34Z while `merge.log` advanced ~40 times. The clean instrument was `loop_state.json`, whose mtime is only touched when `revived or deaths changed`. Before using a count-of-zero as evidence, prove the recorder was recording.

**Per-entry, not per-file, path resolution when auditing manifests.** Assuming one path base per manifest manufactured 7 spurious hits on exam V5 and 9 on engine-rig E15/E16. One manifest mixes two bases inside a single `files[]` array. Try `path`, then `run_dir/path`, then `territory/path`, disk first then history.

**Normalise a `sha256:` prefix before reporting digest mismatches.** Two manifests write `"sha256": "sha256:<hex>"`; normalising took V18 from '14/14 false, worst in the repo' to fully clean. The next auditor who skips this will file V18 as the headline.
**A remedy that makes a probe red on everything is a remedy that gets the probe switched off.** Cost the false-positive rate of a proposed gate before recommending it, not after.

**The fan-out raises coverage; the refuters raise the hit rate.** 11 dimension-8 candidates became 1 report plus an appendix. 6 arc-recon findings became 1 report. 4 stranded items became 0. Do not judge a gatherer by how much it returns.
